exercises.question: Which sentence is about a past that did not happen?
options: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría elegido otra opción. [If I had had more time, I would have chosen another option.]
Si tuviera más tiempo, elegiría otra opción. [If I had more time, I would choose another option.]
Tengo más tiempo. [I have more time.]

exercises.sentence: Si las cosas ___ diferentes, habría aceptado.
exercises.english: If things had been different, I would have accepted.
If I had had more time, I would have chosen another option.

sentences: Primero, no tenía suficiente tiempo. [First, I did not have enough time.]
Después, elegí la primera opción. [Then I chose the first option.]
Finalmente, pensé: «Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría elegido otra opción». [Finally, I thought: “If I had had more time, I would have chosen another option.”]

exercises.question: Which word means «opportunity»?
options: oportunidad [opportunity]
resultado [result]
cambiar [to change]

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tenido la ___, habría aceptado.
exercises.english: If I had had the opportunity, I would have accepted.
If it had been different, I would have accepted.

exercises.sentence: Si las cosas hubieran sido diferentes, habría aceptado.
options: If things had been different, I would have accepted.

Things were different, so I accepted.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
exercises.english: If I had had more information, I would have made a different decision.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué habría pasado si las cosas hubieran sido diferentes?

options: Habría aceptado. [I would have accepted.]
Había aceptado. [I had accepted.]
He aceptado. [I have accepted.]
Habría cambiado la decisión. [The decision would have changed.]
Había cambiado la decisión. [The decision had changed.]
Ha cambiado la decisión. [The decision has changed.]
